game_concept: A strategy race set in Eldritch Ruins – Echoing Courtyard, an echoing courtyard: the relic hunter must handle eldritch shades while practicing lists. Core idea – Length Limit: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Echoing Courtyard.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Echoing Courtyard: an echoing courtyard
core_gameplay_loop: In Echoing Courtyard, repeat each round: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Echoing Courtyard. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the relic hunter ahead. Then check the capacity value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the obelisk by solving code steps involving capacity that move the relic hunter forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the obelisk first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 6 (applied tier): Length Limit
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Length Limit' (Week 7 slot 9), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Echoing Courtyard'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how capacity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against eldritch shades in Echoing Courtyard.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
